answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I spent 3 Sparks with Bag of Tricks to place 3 Bombs on Seapunk, detonated them with Quick Fuse, played Kaboom! on Seapunk, then played Duck and Cover.
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered taking the single-Bomb option on Bag of Tricks to preserve all 3 Sparks, while otherwise playing the same cards.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up all 3 Sparks in exchange for placing two additional Bombs.
answers.q4_different_intent: Yes. If Seapunk had not intended to attack, I would have omitted Duck and Cover.
